note: two-statement exec fires STMT and PROFILE per statement with the SQL C reports (trailing semicolons)
three-statement exec: three STMT + three PROFILE in statement order
prepared statement fires STMT at execution and PROFILE at completion (no semicolon)
fresh connection: pragma_module_list lists only its own lazily-created pragma vtab
create_module names appear; a touched pragma TVF joins the lazy list
PER-ROW expiry: writing a different row leaves the handle readable and writable; writing its own row expires it (rc 4, bytes 0)
deleting a different row leaves the handle live; deleting its own row expires it
TEXT-cell blob writes patch bytes in place and the cell stays TEXT
randomness fills exactly N bytes (tail untouched), draws differ, N=0 writes nothing and the stream continues
test_control PRNG SAVE/RESTORE replays the stream; re-seeding with the same seed replays (within-run predicates, no raw bytes)
